description.value:
You channel a lance of dark energy at a creature within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d12 necrotic damage if it is missing any hit points, or 1d8 necrotic damage if it is at full health.

This damage increases by one die at 5th, 11th, and 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, At-Will
